objective: PIVOT from analyst10 (exhausted, best sh0.66). Test sentiment21/23 on ASI/MINVOL1M. Sentiment is different signal type (news sentiment, mult 1.5). Prior sentiment work was USA - first ASI test.
field_selection_rationale: Top fields by userCount/alphaCount (proven useful): snt23_2neg_std (53 users, 65 alphas - #1 overall), snt21_2pos_std (38 users, 41 alphas - #1 sentiment21), snt21_2neut_std (32 users), snt23_2neg_conf_low (32 users), snt23_2dts_gen_20 (coverage 0.9563 - highest). All MATRIX type, used directly (no vec_avg needed).

design.expr1_snt23_neg_std_baseline: snt23_2neg_std (#1 popularity) + proven template z40. Baseline for cap-decile comparison.
design.expr2_snt23_neg_std_capdecile: snt23_2neg_std + cap-decile z40. Cap-decile helped analyst v1 (+32% sh). Test if it helps sentiment too.
design.expr3_snt21_pos_std_baseline: snt21_2pos_std (#1 sentiment21) + proven z40. Different dataset/field.
design.expr5_snt21_neut_std: snt21_2neut_std (32 users) + proven z40. Neutral sentiment volatility.
design.expr6_snt23_neg_conf_low: snt23_2neg_conf_low (32 users) + proven z40. Level signal (confidence bound, not std). Tests if level or volatility is better.
design.expr7_snt23_dts_gen_20: snt23_2dts_gen_20 (coverage 0.9563, highest) + proven z40. General sentiment score.
design.expr8_snt23_neg_std_z30: snt23_2neg_std + proven z30. z30 was best for asi_jpn per b10/b11.

direction_note: Testing direct direction first. If sharpe is strongly negative, the signal is reversed and we flip in b13. Sentiment _std fields measure volatility (always positive), so ranking is straightforward.
b11_reference: Best analyst10 = pre_fy1_v1+cap-decile sh0.66. Analyst exhausted. Sentiment is new category with mult 1.5.
